Rolebranch is built around one idea: **one master CV, and a tailored copy for every job.** This
guide takes you from sign-up to your first tailored CV in about ten minutes.

## 1. Sign in

Go to [app.rolebranch.com](https://app.rolebranch.com) and sign in with an email link, a password,
Google, Apple or GitHub. An email link works once and for 15 minutes, so open it on the device you
want to use.

## 2. Bring your CV once

Choose **Import from file** and drop in a PDF, Word (DOCX) or plain text file of up to 10 MB.
Rolebranch reads it and shows what it found: basics, experience, projects, education, skills and
languages. Check it, then save it as your **master CV**. Import is free.

No CV yet? Start from scratch: the editor scores your CV as you type and tells you what to fix.

## 3. Add a job you want

Add an application with the posting's link. Romy reads it and shows the role, its requirements, its
keywords and how you match. If the page won't open for her (some sites need a login), paste the
posting's text instead. Reading the posting and the match are free.

## 4. Let Romy tailor a copy

Pick the master CV to start from and choose to tailor it. You see the cost before anything runs: a
tailored CV is **5 credits**. Romy writes from your master CV, never from thin air, and your master
CV doesn't change.

## 5. Approve each change

Every change Romy proposes waits for you: **Accept**, **Edit first**, or **Reject**. If she leaves a
blank, it's a number or fact only you know: fill it in or leave it out. Nothing goes out with your
name on it that you didn't approve.

## 6. Download and apply

Download the PDF (always free), apply on the employer's site, and move the application along your
board as you hear back.
